For more safety tips, visit:
oregonwalkbike.org and
oregonfriendlydriver.org

Always slow down as you approach a
person on a bicycle – and please do not honk!
Wait patiently until it’s safe to pass,
and the next lane is clear.
On roads less than 35 MPH, allow at least
3 feet to avoid contact with the rider. More is
always better!
*ORS 811.065 – Passing of person operating a bicycle
